title: Fix Phantom Build-Flyer Target Admission for Print
description: `repo run @semio-tech/print:test -- quick` fails with BUILD_OWNER_FAILED (Unknown admitted build target: @semio-tech/print:build-flyer) and `repo run @semio-tech/print:test-assignment` hangs in dependencies:store-input-replay/current-input. Find why the build graph admits build-flyer for print, fix at the source, make both targets run, and make the print README advertise only existing targets.
summary: `build-flyer` is a real target synthesized from the Print catalogue; owner discovery did not merge catalogue targets, so admission refused it. Fixing that exposed five more blockers on the repo route, all fixed: generated deps applied before catalogue synthesis (project-nodes), Windows directory fsync EPERM in graph publication, Tectonic "App data directories not supported" under a redirected USERPROFILE, a stale Print command-boundary contract, and a Windows scheduler-lock EPERM. Verified: `repo run @semio-tech/print:test-assignment` exit 0 (20 pass) and `repo run @semio-tech/print:test -- quick` exit 0 (test plus 14 dependencies). README: German id list gained `thesis`; `build-thesis` exists. Details in 🔎️root-cause.md.
